ENTRY_LEVEL.label: Entry Level (0-2 Years)
ENTRY_LEVEL.reasoning_focus: Focus on learning agility, execution of clearly defined tasks, adherence to established standards.
ENTRY_LEVEL.autonomy_level: Operates under direct supervision. Does not own architectural decisions.
ENTRY_LEVEL.risk_avoidance: Eliminate language suggesting ownership of system-wide architecture or budget management.

MID_LEVEL.label: Mid-Senior (5-8 Years)
MID_LEVEL.reasoning_focus: Focus on system optimization, mentorship, and robust design patterns.
MID_LEVEL.autonomy_level: Operates independently on modules; contributes to architecture.
MID_LEVEL.risk_avoidance: Avoid executive-level strategic claims or VP-level stakeholder management.

PRINCIPAL.label: Principal / Leadership (15+ Years)
PRINCIPAL.reasoning_focus: Emphasize enterprise strategy, technical vision, and business impact.
PRINCIPAL.autonomy_level: Defines the roadmap with complete autonomy.
PRINCIPAL.risk_avoidance: Eliminate granular ticket-level task descriptions or language implying subservience.
